# 提示词分类与示例

# 1. 细粒度属性调整
**用途**: 在保持语义和身份的同时调整细粒度属性
**格式**: "描述对象 + 具体属性描述 + 其他描述"

**示例**:
- "... a Ladudu toy character with **black** fur..."
- "... a Ladudu toy character with **golden** fur..."
- "... a Ladudu toy character with **green** fur..."
- "... a Ladudu toy character with **purple** fur..."
- "... a Ladudu toy character with **red** fur..."
- "... a Ladudu toy character with **white** fur..."

### 2. 概念引导 - 变成ladudu角色
**用途**: 将人或物体转换为ladudu娃娃风格
**格式**: "描述主体 + transformed into a laduda toy character..."

**示例**:
- "A young woman with curly hair... transformed into a ladudu toy character..."
- "A stone statue of Abraham Lincoln... transformed into a ladudu toy..."
- "An elderly man with a warm, wrinkled smile... transformed into the head of a ladudu toy monster..."
- "A man with long brown hair... transformed into a large, tan-colored vinyl bunny character head..."
- "A man with a beard... transformed into a furry, light-brown ladudu toy creature..."
- "A man with silver-streaked dark hair and a striped sweater... transformed into a large, stylized vinyl toy character..."
- "A young man wearing a blue puffer jacket... transformed into a ladudu toy character..."
- "A smiling woman with long, wavy hair... transformed into a stylized toy character wearing a pink, fluffy bunny-ear hat."
- "A smiling man with a beard... transformed into a ladudu..."

### 3. 概念引导 - 变成Minecraft角色
**用途**: 将场景或物体转换为Minecraft体素风格
**格式**: "描述主体 + transforms into a voxelated, block-style world/character..."

**示例**:
- "A young man... transforms into a voxelated, block-style world..."
- "A young woman... transforms into a voxelated, Minecraft-style world..."
- "A young boy... transforms into a blocky, voxelated world..."
- "A young woman... transforms into a voxelated, block-style world..."
- "A woman... transforms into a Minecraft-inspired voxel art style..."
- "A macro shot captures an iridescent green beetle... transforms into a fully voxelated, Minecraft-style world..."
- "A live-action red fox... transformed into a voxelated, Minecraft-style world..."
- "A small, white, fluffy dog... transformed into a voxelated, Minecraft-style world..."
- "A young orange tabby cat... transforms into a blocky, voxel-based style reminiscent of Minecraft..."

# 4. 概念引导 - 其他变换
**Squid Game守卫**:
- "A smiling baby... transformed into a Squid Game guard..."
- "A woman in a dark blue dress... transformed into a full red jumpsuit, cinched with a black belt and paired with black gloves."
- "A young woman... morph into a full-body red jumpsuit... transforming her into a Squid Game guard..."

**毛绒玩具**:
- "A young boy... seamlessly transforms into a smiling, soft plush doll..."
- "A bouquet of red roses... replaced by a cute, round, white plush toy..."
- "Four small, black-and-tan Yorkshire Terrier puppies... seamlessly morph into soft, plush forms..."

**肌肉男**:
- "A young man... torso undergoes a transformation; a previously softer physique is replaced by a chiseled, muscular build..."
- "A young man... shirt vanishes, and his torso is revealed to be significantly more muscular and sculpted."
- "A man with a shaved head... transformed into a much more muscular and well-defined version of himself..."

**手办**:
- "A woman... seamlessly transforms into a stylized, chibi-like toy figurine..."
- "A young woman... transforms into a small, stylized plastic figurine of herself."
- "A young woman... seamlessly morphs into a small, cute plastic figurine."

# 5. 概念引导 - 交互效果
**AI恋人坠落**:
- "From the top right of the frame, a man... descends... and they share an intimate kiss..."
- "From the top of the frame, a woman... drops smoothly into the scene... and kisses the side of his respirator..."
- "From the top of the frame, a woman... smoothly descends into view behind him... leaning in to place her hand on his neck in a tender embrace..."
- "A second cat... drops smoothly into the frame from the top."
- "another lighter brown hen smoothly descends into the frame from the top left..."
- "a second tricolor puppy... executes a smooth, continuous drop into the scene."

**液态金属覆盖**:
- "A viscous, reflective gold liquid appears... flowing over its face, large ears, and dripping over the collar."
- "a thick, reflective liquid of molten gold pours onto the frog's head and back."
- "a shimmering silver liquid metal begins to pour over his head and face."
- "A thick, molten liquid begins to pour over the top of its head..."
- "A shimmering, viscous golden liquid begins to pour from the top of the frames..."
- "A shiny, viscous bronze liquid metal begins to pour over the crown of her head..."

**纸片人效果**:
- "The man slides out of the frame... as a single, flat, rigid entity, like a paper cutout..."
- "A giant, photorealistic human hand... pulls him out of the scene..."
- "The man and his guitar are dragged out of the scene as a single, rigid, two-dimensional cutout..."
- "The man, his chair, the cup he holds... all move together as a single, flat, rigid element, sliding away like a paper cutout..."
- "The hand pulls the man's entire figure horizontally to the left, yanking him out of the frame as if he were a flat paper cutout..."
- "her body slides rigidly and without depth, like a flat, two-dimensional paper cutout being dragged away..."

**粽子包裹**:
- "Large, vibrant green leaves suddenly sprout from the fish's sides... The transformation concludes with the clownfish becoming a fish-shaped zongzi..."
- "Two large, vibrant green leaves emerge and wrap around her torso... The effect concludes with the woman completely encased in a green leaf costume resembling a zongzi..."
- "From the base of the cake, large, vibrant green leaves begin to emerge... Finally, a network of thin, tan-colored twine appears, wrapping around the leafy dome and cinching it tightly in the center, securing the package like a traditional zongzi..."

# 6. 风格引导
**吉卜力风格**:
- "The entire scene abruptly transforms into a Ghibli-style animation."
- "the entire live-action scene instantly transforms into a Ghibli-style animation."
- "The realistic scene... begins a gradual transformation into a Ghibli-style animation."
- "The entire live-action scene instantly transitions into a Ghibli-style animation."
- "The entire scene then instantly transforms into a Studio Ghibli-style anime illustration."
- "The scene... smoothly transitions into a Ghibli-style anime illustration."
- "A smooth transformation washes over the entire scene, converting the realistic image into a Ghibli-style animation."
- "The video abruptly transitions from a live-action shot to a Ghibli-style animation."
- "The entire scene smoothly transitions into a Ghibli-style animation."

**辛普森风格**:
- "The entire realistic scene smoothly cross-dissolves into a Simpsons-style animation."
- "The entire realistic photograph smoothly transforms into a cartoon illustration in the iconic style of 'The Simpsons.'"
- "The entire photorealistic scene smoothly transitions into a cartoon animation in the style of The Simpsons."

**盛开风格**:
- "a massive bouquet of pink, orange, and white flowers magically blooms... The entire scene then transforms into a stylized, painterly world."
- "A dense bouquet of pink and white cosmos flowers... suddenly blossoms from the statue's chest."
- "A dense carpet of tiny, colorful flowers and green foliage blooms across the dog's fur..."

# 7. 运动引导 - 膨胀效果
**格式**: "主体描述 + begins to inflate + 描述变化过程 + 结果描述"

**示例**:
- "The horse begins to inflate, its defined, muscular body swelling and rounding into a smooth, balloon-like form..."
- "Her torso suddenly begins to inflate like a balloon..."
- "the detailed texture of the fruit's pulp... transforming the halves into a seamless, unified, bright-orange sphere that resembles a balloon."
- "its body begins to rapidly inflate, swelling outward into a perfect sphere."
- "The bird begins to inflate rapidly, its body swelling and rounding out as its feathery texture smooths into a taut, balloon-like surface."
- "The inflation transforms his midsection into a large, spherical balloon..."

# 8. 运动引导 - 挤压效果
**示例**:
- "the man and his camera instantly transform into a single, soft, white, clay-like object."
- "her entire form instantly transforms into a soft, dough-like material. The hands knead and compress the figure..."
- "the entire group of parrots instantly transforms into a single, cohesive piece of soft, malleable clay."

### 9. 运动引导 - 摇摆舞
**示例**:
- "he raises his arms and clasps his hands behind his head. He then begins a rhythmic, side-to-side swaying motion..."
- "The girl initiates a 'shake it dance' by raising both hands to the sides of her head. She then begins to sway her upper body and head from side to side..."
- "he raises both hands to the back of his head... He then initiates a simple dance, rhythmically swaying his upper body from side to side..."

# 10. 相机引导
**希区柯克变焦**:
- "A smooth Hitchcock zoom commences, where the camera dollies backward away from the boy while the lens simultaneously zooms in."
- "The camera executes a smooth dolly zoom, pulling backward while simultaneously zooming in on her."
- "the camera performs a slow Hitchcock zoom, pushing in towards the man while simultaneously zooming out."
- "A dolly zoom effect is executed, where the camera physically pulls away from her while the lens zooms in."
- "The camera performs a steady Hitchcock zoom, physically moving forward towards the cup while the lens simultaneously zooms out."
- "The camera executes a slow, continuous Hitchcock zoom, pulling away from the hydrant while simultaneously zooming in."

**地球缩小**:
- "The camera immediately begins a continuous and rapid pull-out, ascending straight up and away from the subject... revealing... the distinct curvature of the Earth..."
- "The camera begins a rapid and continuous pull-out, ascending straight up into the atmosphere... which seamlessly transitions into a satellite view of a verdant landmass..."
- "A continuous and rapid pull-out begins... seamlessly dissolves and resolves into a high-altitude, top-down view of the Earth..."

**环绕**:
- "The camera executes a smooth, steady, partial orbit around the money, moving from left to right."
- "The camera performs a slow, smooth clockwise orbit around the cup, which remains stationary."
- "The camera executes a slow, subtle clockwise orbit around the food arrangement."

**左移**:
- "As the camera glides leftward, the entire scene drifts smoothly and uniformly to the right..."
- "The camera executes a smooth, steady pan to the left, causing the entire scene... to drift uniformly across the frame from left to right."
- "The camera begins a slow, steady pan to the left. The man remains static, causing him to drift out of the frame to the right..."

## 提示词规律总结

### 1. 结构规律
- **基础结构**: `主体描述 + 动作描述 + 变化过程 + 结果描述`
- **变换格式**: `主体描述 + transforms into/begins to/transformation关键词 + 目标状态描述`
- **相机格式**: `The camera + 动作描述 + 效果描述 + 主体保持状态`

### 2. 关键词使用规律
- **变换类**: transforms into, morph into, seamlessly transforms into
- **动作类**: begins to, starts to, suddenly, instantly, gradually
- **效果类**: smoothly, rapidly, instantly, seamlessly, continuously
- **相机类**: executes, performs, commences, begins

### 3. 描述详细度规律
- **高度详细**: 包含具体动作、视觉细节、时间进程
- **视觉词汇**: balloon-like, voxelated, clay-like, flat, rigid, smooth
- **色彩描述**: 具体的颜色词汇 (golden, silver, bronze, green, etc.)
- **材质描述**: feathery texture, smooth surface, malleable clay, rigid entity

### 4. 语义控制策略
- **保持核心**: 在变换或效果中保持主体身份特征
- **渐进描述**: 使用 begins to → continues → completes 的递进结构
- **视觉连贯**: 确保变换前后的视觉连续性
- **上下文保持**: 背景和环境保持不变，只变换主体

### 5. 技术特点
- **零样本支持**: 支持未见过的语义概念
- **细粒度控制**: 通过提示词精确控制属性变化
- **多模态兼容**: 支持概念、风格、运动、相机等多种语义控制
- **上下文感知**: 通过参考视频提供语义上下文
one man transforms into a robot
one man holding a gun transforms into a robot
